notes.text: Paywalls and offers: see the paywall canvas
Lottie animation (not drawn in a static frame): ProgressBarNogradient.json, 132 pt, 50 pt up; and Lottie_Gift_Revision.json on top, 140 pt, 25 pt down.
Lottie animation (not drawn in a static frame): assets/Lottie/JSON.json, a 200 × 600 pt frame, centred, over the bar, speed 1.5. First frames: the shield outline starts to draw.

Motion (not drawn in a static frame). After a failed walk the toast slides down from under the top bar in 0.5 s. A swipe up of more than 21 pt slides it away and starts no walk. Try now or Connect starts a new walk at once (6-per-minute cap). It goes away on Try now, Connect or a connection. No automatic retry, no countdown.

Measured on the build (PR #41, 5.0.7 (654.1)), in pt from the top of the screen.
iPhone 17 Pro: toast 154–204, in the middle of grid row 2 (145–213). Connect row starts at 323.
iPhone SE (375 × 667): Get Premium bar ends at 84, toast 85.5–135.5.
Premium user: just under the Premium pill.
Width: 90 % of the row; on iPad at most 420 pt.

Option A: a second text, shown only when the walk failed because the server or the API failed. The network text (left) stays for network failures. Title reuses BOOT.UNREACHABLE_TITLE. Icon: warning.png (the report button icon), tinted white as there. Needs the app to know the cause of the failure.
Option B: one text for every failed walk, in place of the network text. Title reuses ALERTS.PROTOCOL_PARTLY_RETIRED_TITLE. Icon stays wifilow.png. Needs no new logic.
Same toast in both: size, place, motion and Try now as in the current row. New strings: the second lines (EN and AR).

Flow (board, approval 6501f8fe items 8 + 9). Replaces the VPN-225 flow.
1. Prompt: Connect with no VPN configuration. The button turns Connecting and iOS shows its prompt at once. No primer screen. The prompt is iOS's own; the app draws nothing over it.
2. Allow, then the passcode: the press goes on and connects, as today.
3. Help: "Don't Allow" (iOS answers "denied"). A full-screen help screen opens over the top-most view, like "Network blocked" (NSButton blue Try Again, plain Not Now, board card, Palette colours). The picture shows the iOS prompt with Allow ringed in buttonYellow #ffc700; step 2 is the passcode. Try Again asks iOS again at once (a new prompt, no primer, no ad). Not Now closes the screen; Home stays Disconnected.
4. NoPrompt: iOS gave an error and showed no prompt ("load_error" or "error"; today the tap shows nothing, VPN-159). Same screen, with an icon instead of the picture and the Settings path. Try Again asks iOS again.
Question for SecurezoneiOS: a management profile can refuse at once without a prompt, and that comes back as "denied" (1 of the 4 AE users). Can the app tell this apart (for example "denied" in under 1 s)? If yes, show NoPrompt for it; if no, Help.
Picture of the iOS prompt: the drawing in these frames is a stand-in. Before the build, take the real prompt on the board's test iPhone (and an iPad) in English and Arabic and use those images. The Arabic iOS text in the stand-in is not checked against iOS.
iPad: the help screen content is at most 560 pt wide and centred (new; "Network blocked" is full width).
Mac: should follow. The Mac window's "VPN permission" step (Approved, not built — VPN-589, Mac-FirstLaunch-Permission) is the same kind of primer. Proposal: Connect opens the macOS prompt at once, and Mac-FirstLaunch-Denied becomes this help screen. No Mac frames now; I add them if the board wants the Mac in this change.

Texts. NEW = a new user text for the board to approve.
Help screen
- Title: ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_TITLE "VPN configuration not added" (existing).
- Message: "Securezone VPN can't connect without a VPN configuration." NEW key; the words are the first sentence of ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_MESSAGE (existing EN and AR).
- Step 1: "Tap Try Again, then tap Allow." NEW. AR: "اضغط على «إعادة المحاولة» ثم على «السماح»." NEW.
- Step 2: "Enter your iPhone passcode." NEW (iPhone / iPad). AR: "أدخل رمز مرور iPhone." NEW.
- Buttons: ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_RETRY "Try Again", ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_CANCEL "Not Now" (existing).
No-prompt screen
- Title: "iOS did not show the VPN prompt" NEW. AR: "لم يعرض iOS نافذة إذن VPN" NEW.
- Message: "New VPN configurations may be blocked on this device." NEW key; words from ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_MESSAGE.
- Tip: "See Settings › General › VPN & Device Management. Then tap Try Again." NEW key; the path is from ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_MESSAGE, "Then tap …" as in ALERTS.NETWORK_BLOCKED tips.
- Buttons: Try Again, Not Now (existing).
Leave the app: ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_PRIMER_TITLE, _MESSAGE, _CONTINUE, _NOT_NOW (no longer shown). ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_MESSAGE is no longer shown in full.
iOS prompt texts ("Would Like to Add VPN Configurations", "Allow", "Don't Allow") are iOS's, not ours.
Tokens: background #080b13, bar #171d2e, board #131724, blue #839ff2, buttonYellow #ffc700, text #ffffff, cGray #b3b7c3, radius 18. New component: VPNPermissionHelpView (same parts as NetworkBlockedView). New icon on the no-prompt screen: SF Symbol "exclamationmark.triangle", 64 pt, blue, in the 128 pt bar circle as on "Network blocked" (drawn here with the Font Awesome triangle).

Popups (Gift, rating, offers, paywalls, ads) and the permission flow.
Today: one AE user's Try Again and a Gift popup came in the same second, and the press never reached iOS. A Connect press while a popup is on screen closes the popup and does not connect.
Rule (proposal):
1. Hold: from the Connect press until the permission flow ends, the popup queue shows nothing, priority popups too. They wait in the queue in their order. No interstitial or App Open ad.
2. The flow ends when: iOS says Allow and the press goes on; or the user taps Not Now; or the help screen closes in any other way.
3. While iOS's prompt is up the app is inactive; popups that arrive wait (rule 1).
4. The help screen is full screen and counts as "a popup on screen", so ads and the queue stay off while it is up.
5. Try Again on the help screen asks iOS directly. It does not go through the Connect button, so an open popup can never take the tap. A second tap while iOS is asking does nothing.
6. After the flow ends, the queue opens its next popup with the normal 700 ms after-close wait. If the press connects, the popups wait until the button shows Connected.
Question for SecurezoneiOS: which popup was the "Gift popup" on 11-13 (Gift sheet, reward panel or an offer), and did it come from the queue or from the ad layer? The hold must cover that path.

Proposal — VPN-817 (below): the two "before the iOS prompt" frames (EN and AR) leave the flow: Connect opens the iOS prompt at once. The "after a refusal" alert frames are replaced by a full-screen help screen. These frames stay as built until the board approves and the change is on the default branch.

iOS disabled button (NSButton kind .disabled, Palette.buttonDisabled #3c4970). The app uses it on one screen: "Network blocked" while Retry counts down.
Today: black #000000 (Palette.black) on #3c4970 = 2.38:1. Fails 4.5:1.
Proposal: white #ffffff (Palette.text) on #3c4970 = 8.83:1. This is the Mac disabled button (VPN-827). Background, 55 pt height, radius 18, 16 pt semibold, text and countdown do not change. cGray #b3b7c3 was checked too: 4.4:1, fails.
Change in code: NSButtonKind.disabled title = Palette.text. The design system updates the buttonDisabled and black usage notes after the build.
Changes these current frames: iPhone-NetworkBlocked-RetryCountdown EN and AR, iPad-NetworkBlocked-RetryCountdown EN and AR.
Proposal — VPN-908 (below): the Retry button title turns white (8.83:1). These frames stay as built until the board approves and the change is on the default branch.

What changes (board, second card on VPN-1134, Q3 rejected, 2026-11-24): the app shows the server it got.

Who: premium users on Auto only (no saved choice, or Auto chosen in the list). Start state: 5.0.8 (3), "Auto Location" and the tick on the Auto row after a restart (VPN-1067).

1. Before Connect (a): no change. The bar shows "Auto Location" over the country of the app's own pick (made at launch or at a list load), with its flag.
2. Connecting (b): no change. The bar keeps the app's pick. One Connect can try more than one server; the bar does not jump between them.
3. Connected (c, d): the bar shows the flag and the country of the server the user is connected to (the served server of the press: server._id of the /file answer). The change comes at the moment the state becomes Connected. Same country (c): the user sees no change. Another country (d): the flag and the country change. "Auto Location" stays, so the user knows that the app chose.
4. Server list in (d) and (e): the Auto row takes the flag of the served server. The tick stays on the Auto row. The country row (here Germany) gets no tick: the user did not pick it.
5. After a disconnect (e): the bar keeps the server the user got. The app uses it as its Auto pick for the next Connect. The next pick of the app (next launch or next list load) replaces it, as today.
6. A failed Connect: no change. The bar keeps the app's pick.
7. A new server while Connected (reroute, network change): the bar follows, by rule 3.
8. If the served server has no row in the app's list, the bar keeps the app's pick (question for SecurezoneiOS: can this happen?).

No change: free users (their bar stays "Auto Location / Quick Access"), a server picked by hand, the Mac app, the onboarding, the Connect button, the IP and PING bar.

Look: no new token and no new component on the iPhone. The bar is today's Auto layout of ServerSelectButton: "Auto Location" 12 pt medium over the country 13 pt bold, #ffffff on #171d2e (16.78:1), flag 30 × 30, chevron 20 × 20. Arabic: flag on the right, text aligned right, chevron on the left, as today.

iPad: see Proposal — VPN-1179 on the iPad page (the server column's Auto row gets the country).

Frames: launch pick Netherlands; served server in another country Germany. Example data only. Renders use a fallback font (no Apple fonts on the runner); sizes and weights come from the code (master and rc/5.0.8).

Texts. No new text. Every text is an existing key, EN | AR:
• Home bar, line 1: MAIN_PAGE.SERVER_SELECT.AUTO_LOCATION: "Auto Location" | "موقع تلقائي"
• Home bar, line 2, and iPad Auto row, line 2: SERVERS.LIST.<descriptionKey> of the served server, e.g. "Germany" | "ألمانيا", "Netherlands" | "هولندا"
• Server list Auto row and iPad Auto row, line 1: SERVERS.CATEGORIES.AUTO: "Auto Location" | "موقع تلقائي"
• Connect button: today's texts (CONNECTING | جاري الاتصال, STOP | إيقاف).

Lottie animation (not drawn in a static frame): ProgressBarNogradient.json, 132 pt, 50 pt up; and Lottie_Gift_Revision.json on top, 140 pt, 25 pt down.
Lottie animation (not drawn in a static frame): assets/Lottie/JSON.json, a 200 × 600 pt frame, centred, over the bar, speed 1.5. First frames: the shield outline starts to draw.

Flow (board, approval 6501f8fe items 8 + 9). Replaces the VPN-225 flow.
1. Prompt: Connect with no VPN configuration. The button turns Connecting and iOS shows its prompt at once. No primer screen. The prompt is iOS's own; the app draws nothing over it.
2. Allow, then the passcode: the press goes on and connects, as today.
3. Help: "Don't Allow" (iOS answers "denied"). A full-screen help screen opens over the top-most view, like "Network blocked" (NSButton blue Try Again, plain Not Now, board card, Palette colours). The picture shows the iOS prompt with Allow ringed in buttonYellow #ffc700; step 2 is the passcode. Try Again asks iOS again at once (a new prompt, no primer, no ad). Not Now closes the screen; Home stays Disconnected.
4. NoPrompt: iOS gave an error and showed no prompt ("load_error" or "error"; today the tap shows nothing, VPN-159). Same screen, with an icon instead of the picture and the Settings path. Try Again asks iOS again.
Question for SecurezoneiOS: a management profile can refuse at once without a prompt, and that comes back as "denied" (1 of the 4 AE users). Can the app tell this apart (for example "denied" in under 1 s)? If yes, show NoPrompt for it; if no, Help.
Picture of the iOS prompt: the drawing in these frames is a stand-in. Before the build, take the real prompt on the board's test iPhone (and an iPad) in English and Arabic and use those images. The Arabic iOS text in the stand-in is not checked against iOS.
iPad: the help screen content is at most 560 pt wide and centred (new; "Network blocked" is full width).
Mac: should follow. The Mac window's "VPN permission" step (Approved, not built — VPN-589, Mac-FirstLaunch-Permission) is the same kind of primer. Proposal: Connect opens the macOS prompt at once, and Mac-FirstLaunch-Denied becomes this help screen. No Mac frames now; I add them if the board wants the Mac in this change.

Texts. NEW = a new user text for the board to approve.
Help screen
- Title: ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_TITLE "VPN configuration not added" (existing).
- Message: "Securezone VPN can't connect without a VPN configuration." NEW key; the words are the first sentence of ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_MESSAGE (existing EN and AR).
- Step 1: "Tap Try Again, then tap Allow." NEW. AR: "اضغط على «إعادة المحاولة» ثم على «السماح»." NEW.
- Step 2: "Enter your iPad passcode." NEW (iPhone / iPad). AR: "أدخل رمز مرور iPad." NEW.
- Buttons: ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_RETRY "Try Again", ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_CANCEL "Not Now" (existing).
No-prompt screen
- Title: "iOS did not show the VPN prompt" NEW. AR: "لم يعرض iOS نافذة إذن VPN" NEW.
- Message: "New VPN configurations may be blocked on this device." NEW key; words from ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_MESSAGE.
- Tip: "See Settings › General › VPN & Device Management. Then tap Try Again." NEW key; the path is from ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_MESSAGE, "Then tap …" as in ALERTS.NETWORK_BLOCKED tips.
- Buttons: Try Again, Not Now (existing).
Leave the app: ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_PRIMER_TITLE, _MESSAGE, _CONTINUE, _NOT_NOW (no longer shown). ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_MESSAGE is no longer shown in full.
iOS prompt texts ("Would Like to Add VPN Configurations", "Allow", "Don't Allow") are iOS's, not ours.
Tokens: background #080b13, bar #171d2e, board #131724, blue #839ff2, buttonYellow #ffc700, text #ffffff, cGray #b3b7c3, radius 18. New component: VPNPermissionHelpView (same parts as NetworkBlockedView). New icon on the no-prompt screen: SF Symbol "exclamationmark.triangle", 64 pt, blue, in the 128 pt bar circle as on "Network blocked" (drawn here with the Font Awesome triangle).

Popups (Gift, rating, offers, paywalls, ads) and the permission flow.
Today: one AE user's Try Again and a Gift popup came in the same second, and the press never reached iOS. A Connect press while a popup is on screen closes the popup and does not connect.
Rule (proposal):
1. Hold: from the Connect press until the permission flow ends, the popup queue shows nothing, priority popups too. They wait in the queue in their order. No interstitial or App Open ad.
2. The flow ends when: iOS says Allow and the press goes on; or the user taps Not Now; or the help screen closes in any other way.
3. While iOS's prompt is up the app is inactive; popups that arrive wait (rule 1).
4. The help screen is full screen and counts as "a popup on screen", so ads and the queue stay off while it is up.
5. Try Again on the help screen asks iOS directly. It does not go through the Connect button, so an open popup can never take the tap. A second tap while iOS is asking does nothing.
6. After the flow ends, the queue opens its next popup with the normal 700 ms after-close wait. If the press connects, the popups wait until the button shows Connected.
Question for SecurezoneiOS: which popup was the "Gift popup" on 11-13 (Gift sheet, reward panel or an offer), and did it come from the queue or from the ad layer? The hold must cover that path.

Proposal — VPN-817 (below): the two "before the iOS prompt" frames (EN and AR) leave the flow: Connect opens the iOS prompt at once. The "after a refusal" alert frames are replaced by a full-screen help screen. These frames stay as built until the board approves and the change is on the default branch.

iOS disabled button (NSButton kind .disabled, Palette.buttonDisabled #3c4970). The app uses it on one screen: "Network blocked" while Retry counts down.
Today: black #000000 (Palette.black) on #3c4970 = 2.38:1. Fails 4.5:1.
Proposal: white #ffffff (Palette.text) on #3c4970 = 8.83:1. This is the Mac disabled button (VPN-827). Background, 55 pt height, radius 18, 16 pt semibold, text and countdown do not change. cGray #b3b7c3 was checked too: 4.4:1, fails.
Change in code: NSButtonKind.disabled title = Palette.text. The design system updates the buttonDisabled and black usage notes after the build.

iPad server column in a window of 700–830 pt (VPN-589 ipad-check O1).
Today (rc/5.0.8): the column is 36 % of the window, 300…400 pt; from 700 to 832 pt it is 300 pt. A row is flag, name, lock (free user, Premium row), signal icon, tick, 12 pt apart. The name gets 87 pt on a locked row and 112 pt on an open row, so names are cut: "United Kin…", "Netherlan…", "الولايات المت…", "المملكة المت…".
Widths of the names (15 pt semibold, measured on the board's test iPad full screen): United Kingdom 115 pt, Netherlands 88 pt, الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية 160 pt, المملكة المتحدة 104 pt. United Arab Emirates and الإمارات العربية المتحدة are as long.
Proposal (fewer icons; the column width rule does not change):
1. No signal icon in the iPad column. It is the same picture (wifi.png) on every row and shows no measured signal.
2. A locked row shows the yellow lock (13 pt) in the place of the tick (22 pt slot). A locked row is never selected (a tap opens Premium Week), so its tick circle is always empty.
3. The name can take 2 lines (18 pt line height). The row stays 56 pt.
Result: the name gets 144 pt on every row of a 300 pt column. Long names are whole; the longest take 2 lines.
Not chosen: a larger minimum width. To fit 160 pt on one line the column must be 373 pt; then a 700 pt window leaves 326 pt for the main screen, less than an iPhone SE (375 pt).
No change: the iPhone server list, the Auto row, the Start Subscription card, the search field, the column width rule.
Frames: free user (the worst case), 700, 781 and 830 pt windows, 1307 pt high, as the VPN-589 window frames. The Get Premium capsule follows the VPN-589 window rule (whole in English at 830 pt). The list content is a sample with the longest names; the real list comes from server data.
Changes these current frames (the column only): iPad-Main-Landscape* and iPad-Main-PortraitPremium EN and AR, iPad-MainWindow589-NoPremium785 EN and AR, iPad-SettingsSheet-* and iPad-ReportSheet-* (the column behind the sheet).
Proposal — VPN-908 (below): the Retry button title turns white (8.83:1). These frames stay as built until the board approves and the change is on the default branch.

Proposal — VPN-908 (below): the server column loses the signal icon, the lock takes the tick place, names can take 2 lines. These frames stay until the board approves and the change is on the default branch.

Flow: the same rule as the iPhone block (Proposal — VPN-1179 on the iPhone page). These frames show the iPad of 5.0.8 (IPadLayout.swift on rc/5.0.8): in every window of 700 pt and wider, Home has two columns and no home bar. The server column is the server choice.

Today: the column's Auto row shows a bolt and "Auto Location", with no country (ServerSidebarView.swift, rc/5.0.8). So the iPad never shows the country of an Auto server.

The change: when the Auto row is chosen (a premium user on Auto), it gets a second line with the country, by the iPhone rule:
• (a) before Connect and (b) connecting: the country of the app's pick.
• (c, d) connected: the country of the server the user is connected to.
• (e) after a disconnect: the country of the last server the user got.
The tick and the teal edge stay on the Auto row. The country rows get no tick.

No change: a country picked by hand (the Auto row is not chosen and has one line), free users' column, the main column, the Mac app.

Look (existing tokens; no new token):
• Line 1: 15 pt semibold #ffffff on #171d2e (16.78:1), as today.
• Line 2: 13 pt medium #b3b7c3 (Palette.cGray) on #171d2e: 8.37:1. One line, cut with "…" if too long.
• Row height stays 56 pt. In Arabic the lines align right and the row mirrors, as today.
• New in code: one Text line in the Auto row.

Narrow windows (under 700 pt: Split View, Slide Over) use the iPhone layout: the iPhone frames apply. Portrait: the same two columns (1032 pt wide), so no portrait frame.
Base frames: "Approved, not built — VPN-589" (iPad main, landscape, premium). Renders use a fallback font.

Texts. No new text. Every text is an existing key, EN | AR:
• Home bar, line 1: MAIN_PAGE.SERVER_SELECT.AUTO_LOCATION: "Auto Location" | "موقع تلقائي"
• Home bar, line 2, and iPad Auto row, line 2: SERVERS.LIST.<descriptionKey> of the served server, e.g. "Germany" | "ألمانيا", "Netherlands" | "هولندا"
• Server list Auto row and iPad Auto row, line 1: SERVERS.CATEGORIES.AUTO: "Auto Location" | "موقع تلقائي"
• Connect button: today's texts (CONNECTING | جاري الاتصال, STOP | إيقاف).
Proposal — VPN-1179 (below): in the wide iPad window, the server column's Auto row shows the country of the server that premium Auto got. In narrow windows the iPhone frames apply.
Search: the list keeps the locations whose shown name contains the text. English "an" keeps Germany, Netherlands, Japan, France and Canada. Arabic "ان" keeps ألمانيا and اليابان.

Proposal — VPN-908 (below): the server column loses the signal icon, the lock takes the tick place, names can take 2 lines. These frames stay until the board approves and the change is on the default branch.
Proposal — VPN-1179 (below): the Auto row gets a second line with the country of the server that premium Auto got (before Connect: the app's pick).

Get Premium capsule in a wide window (built in 5.0.8; VPN-589 window card, board 2026-11-17).
The capsule is at most the main column less 2 × 68 pt (English) or 2 × 48 pt (Arabic). It shows the subtitle only when the whole capsule fits in that width. Otherwise it shows the diamond, "Get Premium" / "تمتع بالأفضل" and the chevron: no subtitle and no "…". Pictures of build 41898287: the short capsule in windows of 700 and 785 pt (English and Arabic) and in Arabic at 858 pt; the whole capsule in English at 858 pt and in full screen.
Windows narrower than 700 pt and the iPhone show the Get Premium banner, not the capsule.
The 785 pt frames: a window at the top of the screen; the status bar covers the top 32 pt. The window buttons are the system's closed controls, drawn as a stand-in. They are not an app element.

Proposal — VPN-908 (below): the server column loses the signal icon, the lock takes the tick place, names can take 2 lines. These frames stay until the board approves and the change is on the default branch.

"Server Location" heading (built in 5.0.8, step 6f, commit 1d8c1f78).
Full screen: the column keeps the 32 pt status bar; the heading is 20 pt below it (52 pt from the top of the screen), in English and Arabic, also after a switch from a window. The frames leave the status bar empty.
A window: the column under the window buttons starts below them (heading 95 pt from the top of the screen); the other column does not move.

Since 5.0.8 (VPN-589) a window of 700 pt or more, full screen included, shows the server column and this main column (at most 560 pt, centred). Windows narrower than 700 pt keep the iPhone layout with the bottom server bar. The full-screen rows "Home — free user", "Home — premium user", "Home — notices" and "Server list" show the layout before 5.0.8; the Home rows wait for the 5.0.8 (3) screenshots (VPN-1205).

Since 5.0.8 (VPN-589) the Settings and the Profile tab open this one sheet in a window of 700 pt or more, full screen included: a list of 320 pt and the page, at most 1000 × 720 pt, over the dimmed window. notes.text: Paywalls and offers: see the paywall canvas

Forced: the Mac app asks /app-management/app-version/macos once per launch, as iOS asks its route. If this build is below the minimum, the window and the menu bar panel show only this card. Card values and strings are the iOS update page (UpdateRequiredView, UPDATE_REQUIRED.*). Update opens the app's store page. The ✕ closes the window only; the app stays blocked.
Optional: iOS has no optional update page. It shows the server notice band "update-recommended" (ClientNoticeBandView, CLIENT_NOTICE.*). The Mac shows the same band at the top of the window home. ✕ hides it.
These frames replace "update required" in Proposal — VPN-710 M1 if the board approves them.

Mac primary button (.m-btn.blue): 44 high, radius 22, 14 bold, padding 0 28. Shape, size and gradient stay.
Today: white #ffffff on the gradient #5db9eb → #6f8fee (connectGradientTop / connectGradientBottom) = 2.19:1 to 3.07:1. Fails 4.5:1.
Proposal (contrast measured, WCAG 2 formula, at both gradient ends):
- Normal: text #080b13 (background token) on #5db9eb → #6f8fee = 9.00:1 to 6.41:1.
- Pressed: the gradient with 15% white on top, #75c4ee → #85a0f1, text #080b13 = 10.20:1 to 7.77:1. A lighter press, as dark-mode Mac buttons do. Not opacity 0.5 (the iOS press), because that drops the text below 4.5:1.
- Disabled: #3c4970 (buttonDisabled token), text #ffffff = 8.83:1. Not opacity 0.5. Example: Retry counts down (ALERTS.NETWORK_BLOCKED_RETRY_IN "Retry in %@" / "إعادة المحاولة بعد %@").
- An icon in the button (Settings › Support "Report an Issue") takes the text colour: same ratios, at least 3:1.
Precedent: dark text on light blue is in the app already: the update page button #0b1020 on #839ff2 = 7.40:1; the yellow premium button #080b13 on #ffc700.
Not proposed: white text would need the gradient about 35% darker (#3c7899 → #485d9b, 4.84:1 to 6.34:1). That changes the brand colour.
New tokens: none. New values: pressed gradient #75c4ee → #85a0f1 (gradient + 15% #ffffff).
Mac frames that use this button (screen canvas, 30): Mac-FirstLaunch-Privacy (Confirm Agreement), Mac-FirstLaunch-Permission (Continue), Mac-FirstLaunch-Denied (Try Again), Mac-Launch-Offline (Try again), Mac-Launch-Unreachable (Try again), Mac-Launch-NetworkBlocked (Retry), Mac-Launch-UpdateRequired (Update), Mac-Rating-High and Mac-Rating-Low (Send feedback), Mac-Rating-RateUs (YES), Mac-Report-Slow (Send), Mac-Billing-Grace and Mac-Billing-Paused (Update payment), Mac-Settings-Account (Manage Subscription), Mac-Settings-Support (Report an Issue, Send); each EN and AR.
Paywall canvas (6): Mac-NoPlacement-G1PremiumActive-Default, -G4LowRating-Default, -P7TrialTimeline-Default, EN and AR.
Not this button: Mac-UpdateRequired-Window / -MenuBar (VPN-768) use the update page button (#0b1020 on #839ff2, passes).

Flow (board: "Mac follows" on the VPN-817 card, 2026-11-16; approval 6501f8fe items 8 + 9). The Mac does what VPN-817 does on iOS. Built after VPN-589 merges.
1. First launch: Welcome (privacy) stays. "Confirm Agreement" no longer opens the "VPN permission" step: the window goes on as after Allow today (no premium: the paywall with the trial, board S3; premium: the menu bar panel).
2. Prompt: Connect with no VPN configuration (the ring in the menu bar panel or in the window, the menu command, Cmd+Return). The status turns Connecting and macOS shows its prompt at once. No primer. The prompt is macOS's own, in the middle of the screen; the app draws nothing over it. Frames PanelPrompt and WindowPrompt show where the press comes from.
3. Allow, then (if the Mac asks) the password or Touch ID: the press goes on and connects.
4. Help: "Don't Allow" (macOS answers "denied"). The app window opens (if closed) with the help page, like "Network blocked": a picture of the macOS prompt with Allow ringed in #ffc700 (Brand.premium), step 2 is the Mac's confirm step. Try Again asks macOS again at once (a new prompt, no primer). Not Now or ✕ closes the page; the window and the panel show Not connected. This replaces the "permission denied" page (Mac-FirstLaunch-Denied).
5. NoPrompt: macOS gave an error and showed no prompt (for example a device-management profile). Same page, with an icon instead of the picture, the macOS settings path, Try Again, Open System Settings (System Settings › VPN, MacDesignModel.vpnSettingsURL, as today) and Not Now.
6. "Connect when the app opens" (Settings › General): with no VPN configuration it does not start the prompt by itself; the prompt comes on the first click. Question for SecurezoneiOS: does the app know "no configuration" before it connects on open?
Stand-in: the macOS prompt picture is a drawing (VPN-589 drawing, MacFirstLaunchView.systemAlertSample, with the app icon file iTunesArtwork.png). Its colours (#2a2d35, Allow #0a84ff) are macOS's, not ours. Its Arabic wording is not checked. SecurezoneiOS takes the real macOS prompt on the Mac (English and Arabic) and uses it in place of the drawing, with Allow ringed, as on iOS (board choice "Real iOS prompt picture").

Texts. NEW = a new user text for the board to approve. EN / AR.
Help page
- Title: ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_TITLE "VPN configuration not added" / "لم تتم إضافة إعداد VPN" (existing).
- Message: "Securezone VPN can’t connect without a VPN configuration." / "لا يمكن لـ Securezone VPN الاتصال بدون إعداد VPN." (VPN-817 text, on the board card).
- Step 1: "Click Try Again, then click Allow." / "انقر «إعادة المحاولة» ثم انقر «السماح»." NEW (Mac: click, انقر, as the VPN-589 Mac texts).
- Step 2, the Mac's confirm step: "If your Mac asks, enter your password or use Touch ID." / "إذا طلب جهاز Mac ذلك، أدخل كلمة السر أو استخدم Touch ID." NEW here (the words are VPN-589 permStep3).
- Buttons: ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_RETRY "Try Again" / "إعادة المحاولة", ALERTS.VPN_PERMISSION_DENIED_CANCEL "Not Now" / "ليس الآن" (existing; VPN-817 buttons).
No-prompt page
- Title: "macOS did not show the VPN prompt" / "لم يعرض macOS نافذة إذن VPN" NEW (VPN-817 title with macOS).
- Message: "New VPN configurations may be blocked on this Mac." / "قد تكون إضافة إعدادات VPN جديدة محظورة على جهاز Mac هذا." NEW (VPN-817 message with "this Mac").
- Tip, the macOS settings path: "See System Settings › VPN and System Settings › General › Device Management. Then click Try Again." / "راجع إعدادات النظام › VPN وإعدادات النظام › عام › إدارة الجهاز. ثم انقر «إعادة المحاولة»." NEW. Path from web search results (macOS 13 and later; macOS 15: General › Device Management). SecurezoneiOS checks the path names on the Mac in English and Arabic.
- Link: "Open System Settings" / "فتح إعدادات النظام" (VPN-589, existing).
Leave the app: permTitle, permBody, permStep1, permStep2, continueButton, notNow ("Not now", first launch only) and deniedBody (MacText, VPN-589). permStep3 moves to step 2.
Button: the Mac primary button of VPN-827 (board approved): text #080b13 on #5db9eb → #6f8fee, 9.00:1 to 6.41:1.
Contrast (WCAG 2): white on #080b13 19.67:1; #b3b7c3 on #080b13 9.81:1; white on the card #171d2e 16.78:1; link #7f9fef on #080b13 7.59:1; step numbers #080b13 on #6f8fee 6.41:1 (VPN-589 had white, 3.2:1); icons #5db9eb on #171d2e 7.67:1, #ffc700 on #080b13 12.57:1.
Fonts: the runner has no SF fonts; the renders use a stand-in. Righteous has no Arabic letters, so Arabic titles fall back, as in the VPN-589 frames.

Popups and the permission flow (as VPN-817).
The Mac has no ads and no Gift popup. What can open by itself on the Mac: the paywall page (no premium), the rating card after a session (VPN-710 M3, proposal), the update page or band (VPN-768, proposal) and notice bands.
1. Hold: from the Connect press until the flow ends, none of these opens. They wait and open after the flow, in their order.
2. The flow ends when: macOS says Allow and the press goes on; or the user clicks Not Now or ✕; or the help page closes in any other way.
3. While macOS's prompt is up the app is not active; anything that arrives waits (rule 1).
4. The help page fills the window and counts as "a page on screen", so nothing else opens over it.
5. Try Again asks macOS directly. It does not go through the Connect ring. A second click while macOS is asking does nothing.
6. If the press connects, waiting items open when the status shows Connected.

Proposal — VPN-855 (below): the "VPN permission" frames (Mac-FirstLaunch-Permission EN and AR) leave the flow: Connect opens the macOS prompt at once. The "permission denied" frames (Mac-FirstLaunch-Denied EN and AR) are replaced by the help page. Privacy stays. These frames stay as approved until the board approves and the change is on the default branch.

Mac app icon (proposal). Made from the iPhone icon iTunesArtwork@2x.png; not redrawn. The iPhone and iPad icon does not change.
• Shape: 824 × 824 px continuous-corner square in the 1024 px canvas, 100 px margin, transparent outside. Drop shadow black 30 %, y 10, blur 10. Grid values from web sources on the macOS icon template (no Apple page opened).
• Background: vertical gradient #6E92EF → #2641A8, measured from the artwork (fit error 0.3 of 255).
• Files (design-system/project/assets/MacAppIcon/): icon_16x16 … icon_512x512@2x.png (10 files, the macOS asset catalog set) and Contents.json (idiom mac); MacAppIcon-1024.png (master).
• macOS 26 and 27 draw an icon in 6 looks (Default, Dark, Clear light and dark, Tinted light and dark). An asset catalog icon shows Default only. For the other looks the build needs an Icon Composer .icon file made from 3 layers: MacAppIcon-Layer1-Background, -Layer2-Shield (white shield with its blue glow), -Layer3-Check (1024 px, full bleed; Icon Composer adds the shape). The layers are cut from the artwork pixels (they recompose to the artwork, mean error 0.2 of 255), because the repository has no vector mark.
• The Dark, Clear and Tinted pictures are approximate. macOS makes them; SecurezoneiOS checks them in Icon Composer's preview on the Mac.
• Small sizes: at 16 and 32 px the shield and check stay readable on both desktops. Contrast of the white shield on the background behind it: 3.3:1 at its top tip to 7.8:1 at its bottom (icons need 3:1). The top corners of the square (#6E92EF, 2.99:1) touch no shield.

In place. The grey squares are stand-ins for other apps (no other app's icon is drawn). Finder and the prompt are stand-ins drawn in the frames' style; the board takes the real prompt picture on TestFlight (VPN-922 row T2).
• Finder: Applications in icon view, 64 pt, app selected. AR: macOS in Arabic, window buttons on the right, sidebar on the right. The app name stays "Securezone VPN" in every language (InfoPlist.strings).
• Prompt: the icon is drawn 60 px with its transparent margin, so the shape is 48 px, as the VPN-855 drawing. AR uses macOS's own lines (see the next row).
• No Dock frame: the app is menu-bar only and has no Dock icon (VPN-1241).

Changes against the VPN-855 frames (above, current design of the help page and the prompt stand-in). Everything else is the same.
1. All 6 frames: the prompt shows the Mac icon (icon_128x128.png at 60 px, shape 48 px) in place of the iPhone iTunesArtwork with 11 px corners. After approval SecurezoneiOS replaces PermissionPromptAppIcon.png with icon_128x128.png and draws it at 60 pt, so the shape stays 48 pt as today.
2. The 3 AR frames: the prompt's title and message are macOS's own 2 lines (VPN-922 design review item 4), from VPN-922 build report §2:
   Title: يرغب "Securezone VPN" في إضافة تكوينات VPN (was: يرغب «Securezone VPN» في إضافة إعدادات VPN)
   Message: قد تتم فلترة أو مراقبة كل نشاط الشبكة على هذا الـ Mac عند استخدام VPN. (was: قد تتم تصفية كل نشاط الشبكة على جهاز Mac هذا أو مراقبته عند استخدام VPN.)
   SecurezoneiOS confirms each character (the quote marks) from macOS's NetworkExtension strings in its next VPN-922 hand-back; the frames follow that.
3. Buttons, Allow mark, steps and the rest of the page: no change. EN text: no change (it is macOS's line word for word).
Proposal — VPN-1226 (below): these frames' macOS prompt takes the new Mac app icon, and in AR macOS's own 2 lines. See the row "the VPN-855 frames that draw the macOS prompt".

Redrawn from the build (VPN-1255, code on rc/5.0.8): the window is 520 × 732, a 32 pt transparent title-bar strip (MacWindowChrome) above the 520 × 700 page (BrandMetrics.smallWindow). The home column is 368 pt (MacWindowHome width 400 minus MacPanelView padding 16 on each side) and starts 36 pt below the page top (20 + 16); the footer ends 24 pt above the bottom (8 + 16). Icons in the app are SF Symbols (xmark, power, gearshape, exclamationmark.bubble, diamond, chevron.forward, bolt.fill, lock.fill, magnifyingglass, checkmark, xmark.circle.fill, laptopcomputer.and.iphone) at the code's point sizes. SF Symbols cannot be copied as files: the frames draw the closest Font Awesome glyph at that size, and each glyph names its SF Symbol (data-sf).

notes.text:
Products and offers — App Store Connect (read 2026-11-12, VPN-730) and the Adapty export (2026-11-12)
Prices on the frames are samples. The App Store sets the real price per storefront. The prices below are the United States storefront. Adapty's USD value is not the store price.
Adapty's offer ids are not in App Store Connect. They are matched by the remote config offer_id (sz_*), by the paywall name (Promotional Deal 1–3) and by the text (Ramadan, "3 days free").

• Weekly · com.digitstudios.securezonevpn.week · 1 week · $8.99 · introductory: free trial, 3 days · promotional: promotional1 (pay up front, 1 month, $0.99; Adapty 2a256fe3, Promotional Deal 1), sz_week_back20_2w (pay as you go, 1 week × 2, $7.29; Adapty 26afe87d, sz_p1_z1_old), WeeklyPromotional2 (free trial, 3 days; Adapty 2ca2dbd6, Ramadan) · placements: GET_PREMIUM, GET_PREMIUM_WEEK, SERVER_FULL, BILLING_PERIOD, ONBOARDING_START, PROMOTIONAL_DEAL_1, sz_z1_time_wall, sz_k4_trial_setup, the push / OneLink placements, ramadan_2026 (not live)
• Monthly · com.digitstudios.securezonevpn.month · 1 month · $14.99 · introductory: free trial, 3 days · promotional: sz_month_save25_1m (pay as you go, 1 month, $11.49; Adapty 164dc3a6, sz_p5_s2), sz_month_3m35 (pay up front, 3 months, $29.49; Adapty d84828f2, sz_p5_s3), promotional2 and promotional3 (pay as you go, 1 month, $0.99; Adapty 0c7acae2 and 9dd6c4d0, Promotional Deal 2 and 3, not live) · placements: GET_PREMIUM, SERVER_FULL, BILLING_PERIOD, ONBOARDING_START, sz_z1_time_wall (arm B, former subscriber), sz_s2_trial_cancel, sz_s3_weekly_cancel
• Monthly 1-week trial · com.digitstudios.securezonevpn.month.trial1w · 1 month · $14.99 · introductory: free trial, 1 week · no promotional offer · App Store state READY_TO_SUBMIT (not approved yet) · placements: sz_z1_time_wall (arm A), sz_k4_trial_setup
• Yearly · com.digitstudios.securezonevpn.year · 1 year · $79.99 · introductory: free trial, 3 days · no promotional offer · placements: GET_PREMIUM, SERVER_FULL, BILLING_PERIOD, ONBOARDING_START, sz_z1_time_wall
• Monthly Introductory · com.digitstudios.securezonevpn.monthly.introductory · 1 month · $8.99 · group Promotions · no introductory or promotional offer · only in "Introdutory Offer" (INTRODUCTORY_DEAL_1, retired, not live)
Win-back offers: none. Offer codes: 3, all from 2024; their codes are expired or inactive.
sz_k4_trial_setup: priority 0 sz_holdout and priority 2 All users get flow szf_off: no offer page. Segment rules: the Adapty export gives only the segment names and their order, not the rules.
sz_s2_trial_cancel: priority 0 sz_holdout and priority 2 All users get flow szf_off: no offer page. Segment rules: the Adapty export gives only the segment names and their order, not the rules.
sz_s3_weekly_cancel: priority 0 sz_holdout and priority 2 All users get flow szf_off: no offer page. Segment rules: the Adapty export gives only the segment names and their order, not the rules.

sz_z1_time_wall: priority 0 sz_holdout and priority 6 All users get flow szf_off. szf_off means no offer page: the app shows No time left (screen canvas, row "No time left"). Segment rules: the Adapty export gives only the segment names and their order, not the rules.

Purchase failed: no screenshot yet, so no frame (see the missing list on VPN-726). The app shows the system alert (EntitlementsAlert.purchaseFailed through UIKitDialogPresenter.alert), the same on every app-drawn paywall.

Adapty draws a placement only when a push or a OneLink names it. Push: data.target = the placement id (any id except promotional1–3, introductory1 and the retired placements) → PopupQueue → AdaptyPaywallPresenter → AdaptyAdapter.presentPaywall (Adapty.getFlow → AdaptyUI.flowController). OneLink: only the 16 ids in DeepLinkTargetResolver.knownPlacements. Full answer: paywalls document on VPN-726.
• GetPremium template: APP_START, DID_YOU_LOVE_US, SETTINGS_PAGE, WATCH_ADS_PREMIUM, and GET_PREMIUM, SERVER_FULL, BILLING_PERIOD by push.
• GetPremiumWeeky template: HOME_PAGE_TOP, SERVER_MENU, and GET_PREMIUM_WEEK by push.
• Onboarding template: ONBOARDING_END, and ONBOARDING_START by push.
These three are Adapty's untouched templates (English only, sample texts, links to google.com). Frames: Adapty's builder preview as the operator exported it (small images, iPhone 15 Pro). See Proposals on VPN-726.

Not live: no code names ramadan_2026. A push with data.target "ramadan_2026" would show it with no app update. Frames: Adapty's builder preview as the operator exported it (iPhone 15 Pro 393 × 852 / iPad 10.2" 810 × 1080, scaled to the frame); prices are Adapty's samples. The Arabic text faults are in Adapty (see Proposals on VPN-726).

Draft — not live — Introdutory Offer (INTRODUCTORY_DEAL_1), Promotional Deal 2 (PROMOTIONAL_DEAL_2), Promotional Deal 3 (PROMOTIONAL_DEAL_3): no frames.
They are retired (VPN-225, PopupKind.retiredDealPlacements). The app opens GET_PREMIUM for them, also in the screen gallery (sheet.introductory1, sheet.promotional2, sheet.promotional3 show Get Premium). So no screenshot of their own screen exists, and they are not redrawn.

Frames are screenshots, not redrawn (board, 2026-11-15).
• Offer moments (sz_* rows, Release B) and the loading states: VPN-723 screen gallery, master@5c650e22 = 5.0.7 (4), iPhone 17 Pro and iPad Pro 13" simulators, dark.
• iPhone loaded states (Get Premium, Get Premium Week, onboarding page 4, Promotional Deal 1, Servers full, Billing Period): VPN-671 screen gallery, 3e506e01 = 5.0.6 (2). Their views and texts are unchanged up to master 34c04ab6, except a dimmed buy button while products load (VPN-690), which only the loading state shows.
• Push or OneLink only and the Ramadan draft: Adapty's builder previews from the operator.
A state with no screenshot has no frame; the missing list is in the paywalls document on VPN-726.

Proposal — VPN-1032 · loading box after a push tap · waits for the board's card; nobody builds it before approval.

Today (VPN-1005): after a push tap that opens an Adapty paywall, flow or offer, Home stays as it was, with no sign of loading, and takes taps. The wait is 0.1–1.3 s on a fast network, up to about 5 s on a slow one, up to about 40 s the first time a paywall shows on a device. A failed load shows nothing. A tap during the wait can lose the offer, and Connect does not connect.

The box: the app's own page spinner, NSPageSpinner (Design System card NSPageSpinner; SZDesign/Controls/NSSpinner.swift). Scrim spinnerScrim rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.703) over the whole screen, safe areas included; the white system activity indicator (medium, tinted text #ffffff, box activityIndicatorSize 30 pt) in the centre. No new component, no new token.
Texts: none. No new text (EN and AR). VoiceOver reads the system label of the indicator.
Arabic: nothing mirrors; Home under it is the current Arabic Home.

Where the box shows:
• Paywall and flow pushes: over any Home tab (Home, Settings, Profile), from the push tap until the paywall or flow is on screen.
• Offer pushes: until the offer page P1, P5 or P7 is on screen.
• Cold start: from the end of the splash (it does not show on top of the splash).
• iPhone and iPad (same path). Mac: no frames, the Mac app gets no pushes.

The screen under the box takes no touches: no tab change, no Connect, no server change (NSPageSpinner already takes every tap). A new push tap during the wait replaces the old request.

Time limit: 8 s from the push tap (cold start: from the end of the splash). Reason: it covers the slow-network case (about 5 s) with margin; a longer block keeps the user from the VPN for too long. A load that fails before 8 s ends the wait at once. A paywall that arrives after the limit does not show.

After the time limit or a failed load, the board chooses:
(a) the app's own Get Premium screen (current frames iPhone-GET_PREMIUM-GetPremium-Loaded-EN and -AR, no change), or
(b) nothing: the box goes away and Home stays.
Recommended: (a). The user tapped a push to see an offer; (a) still shows them a way to buy, and the failure is not silent. For offer pushes, (a) shows the normal Get Premium prices, not the offer price.

Frames: the current Home free idle frame (screen canvas, Home — notices · page spinner) is the same picture; these frames are its copy for this proposal.

Proposal — VPN-1032 · loading box after a push tap · waits for the board's card; nobody builds it before approval.

Today (VPN-1005): after a push tap that opens an Adapty paywall, flow or offer, Home stays as it was, with no sign of loading, and takes taps. The wait is 0.1–1.3 s on a fast network, up to about 5 s on a slow one, up to about 40 s the first time a paywall shows on a device. A failed load shows nothing. A tap during the wait can lose the offer, and Connect does not connect.

The box: the app's own page spinner, NSPageSpinner (Design System card NSPageSpinner; SZDesign/Controls/NSSpinner.swift). Scrim spinnerScrim rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.703) over the whole screen, safe areas included; the white system activity indicator (medium, tinted text #ffffff, box activityIndicatorSize 30 pt) in the centre. No new component, no new token.
Texts: none. No new text (EN and AR). VoiceOver reads the system label of the indicator.
Arabic: nothing mirrors; Home under it is the current Arabic Home.

Where the box shows:
• Paywall and flow pushes: over any Home tab (Home, Settings, Profile), from the push tap until the paywall or flow is on screen.
• Offer pushes: until the offer page P1, P5 or P7 is on screen.
• Cold start: from the end of the splash (it does not show on top of the splash).
• iPhone and iPad (same path). Mac: no frames, the Mac app gets no pushes.

The screen under the box takes no touches: no tab change, no Connect, no server change (NSPageSpinner already takes every tap). A new push tap during the wait replaces the old request.

Time limit: 8 s from the push tap (cold start: from the end of the splash). Reason: it covers the slow-network case (about 5 s) with margin; a longer block keeps the user from the VPN for too long. A load that fails before 8 s ends the wait at once. A paywall that arrives after the limit does not show.

After the time limit or a failed load, the board chooses:
(a) the app's own Get Premium screen (current frames iPhone-GET_PREMIUM-GetPremium-Loaded-EN and -AR, no change), or
(b) nothing: the box goes away and Home stays.
Recommended: (a). The user tapped a push to see an offer; (a) still shows them a way to buy, and the failure is not silent. For offer pushes, (a) shows the normal Get Premium prices, not the offer price.

Frames: the current Home free idle frame (screen canvas, Home — notices · page spinner) is the same picture; these frames are its copy for this proposal.

• NEW OFFERS.TIME_WALL.THEN_PRICE: "then %1$@/week" | "ثم %1$@ في الأسبوع" → "then $8.99/week" (former subscribers, second line)
• Plan names (exist, now 14 pt grey on the top line): Monthly | شهري · Weekly | أسبوعي
• Badges (unchanged): 1 week free | أسبوع مجانًا · 3 days free | 3 أيام مجانًا · 18% off for 2 weeks | خصم 18% لمدة أسبوعين
Timeline (arms A and B):
• OFFERS.TRIAL_SETUP.FIRST_CHARGE (exists, text unchanged): "%1$@: first charge of %2$@" | "%1$@: أول دفعة بقيمة %2$@". New value of %2$@ = the main price with its period → "November 30: first charge of $14.99/month" | "30 نوفمبر: أول دفعة بقيمة $14.99 شهريًا"; arm B "November 26: first charge of $8.99/week" | "26 نوفمبر: أول دفعة بقيمة $8.99 في الأسبوع". P7 (trial setup page) uses the same text with the bare price; it is not changed here.
Unchanged (for reference): title, subtitles, "Premium: no limits", "Today: full access", the cancel line, the video strip, buttons, footer terms (TERMS_MONTHLY_TRIAL, TERMS_WEEKLY_TRIAL, TERMS_DISCOUNT), Restore · Terms of Use · Privacy Policy.
